rates.interval: Leaf spot, Rhizoctonia brown patch, leaf rust, stem rust, and stripe rust; begin when disease appears and follow the label interval
Copper spot, Fusarium blight, red thread, and slime molds; repeat at 7-14 day intervals
Gray leaf spot; begin at first sign and apply at 5-day intervals or more often when conditions favor disease
Algae; begin when algae appears and repeat at 7-day intervals
Dollar spot and pink snow mold; follow the disease-specific timing and interval on the label
Leaf spot and Rhizoctonia brown patch during favorable disease conditions; repeat at 3-5 day intervals
Pythium blight; begin at first sign and repeat at 5-day intervals or more often when conditions favor disease

products.notes: FRAC M03 broad-spectrum contact protectant fungicide. Professional golf-course and lawn applications are non-WPS uses; keep unprotected persons out until sprays have dried. The agricultural WPS REI is 24 hours. Apply in sufficient water for thorough coverage. Do not use on grasses grown for seed or intended for grazing, and do not graze treated areas or feed clippings to livestock. Use disease-specific rates and intervals; follow the linked label for all directions and restrictions.
